title: Agents keyboard · round 2 · B, final
intro: Claude Design, 25 Nov. The user picked B (Esc steps out, ⌘. stops) with ⌃⇥ for the last session; the Esc change ships with a “⌘. stops” hint (4 s, first 20 times); session numbers skip asides and graph steps. Their nuance: an Esc that no view takes reaches the window, and in full screen AppKit then leaves full screen.

Measured in the test app before the round: tree focused, a key monitor takes Esc; composer focused, Esc stops a running turn or the text view takes it; the leaks are (d) a row click while typing drops focus and (e) a click on transcript text or a card area gives focus to the hosting view, so Esc goes on to the window.

Ruling: every Agents pane (tree, transcript, composer, cards, aside, 640 drawer) takes every Esc, also where there is nothing to step out of (the status bar says so); a row click gives the tree key focus, a transcript click focuses that block. Full screen ends only with ⌃⌘F, Globe F or the green button. A second way out that is not Esc: ⌥⌘← ↑ ↓ → go straight to tree, transcript, composer, aside, from the composer too; ⌃[ stays an Esc alias.
⌘O stays Open Folder…; “open in nvim” on a focused file block moves to gf, and the diff card prints gf only while its block has the bar.
